data.description:
# Herdr selection list: remove the epic icon

## Problem statement

The herdr selection list shows a dedicated `⊙` (U+2299) icon for epic work items. This is now redundant: the list already renders an expand/collapse arrow (`▶`/`▼`) for every item with children — which includes epics — so the indicator adds noise without information.

## Users

- Herdr operators scanning the selection list for the next work item.

Example user stories:

- As a herdr operator, I want epic items to be identified by their expandable children arrow (like any other parent item), so the `⊙` icon does not add redundant visual noise to the list.
- As a herdr operator, I want an epic's Type to remain visible as the plain `epic` label in the list and detail views, so the issue type stays identifiable after the icon is gone.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The selection list rows no longer render the epic icon (`⊙`) for epic items — `getIconPrefixParts()` drops the column-4 epic suffix — while non-epic rows are unaffected and the item-ID column alignment (fixed `ICON_PREFIX_WIDTH`) is preserved. Verified by updated unit tests over `getIconPrefixParts`/`getIconPrefix`.
- [ ] The metadata panel `Type` row and the hover tooltip `Type` line render the plain `epic` label (no `⊙`), consistent with the list. Verified by updated `buildMetaRows` and `formatTooltipLines` tests (currently pin `⊙ epic`).
- [ ] The epic glyph is removed from the icon-legend catalog (`ICON_LEGEND` + `iconLegendGlyphs()`) and its `'epic'` category is dropped from the legend coverage test, so the legend drift guard still passes.
- [ ] The now-unused epic icon helpers and constants are deleted from `@worklog/shared/icons` (`epicIcon`, `EPIC_ICON`, `EPIC_FALLBACK`) and from the CLI's `src/theme.ts` (`epicIcon`, `epicLabel`, `epicFallback`, `EPIC_ICON`, `EPIC_FALLBACK`, `EPIC_LABEL`), along with their unit tests, and the build has no dangling imports/exports. Verified by updated unit tests in `tests/herdr/icons.test.ts` and `tests/unit/icons.test.ts`.
- [ ] All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, module doc comments in `packages/shared/src/icons.ts` and `packages/herdr/src/worklist.ts`, and the herdr README sections that document the epic legend category heading and the `Type` row's epic icon.
- [ ] Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

## Constraints

- Do not change the worklog issue-type vocabulary or the `epic` text label itself — only the icon.
- Preserve the fixed-width icon-prefix alignment contract (`ICON_PREFIX_WIDTH`); removing a column must not shift the item-ID column.
- Keep the list/metadata/tooltip icon consistency invariant (WL-0MSGIXHHI009KFW9) — all three render plain `epic` after the change.
- No CLI/socket/API behaviour change; this is a display-only change.
- Write in UK English; follow the project's test/build conventions.

## Existing state

- `packages/shared/src/icons.ts` — `EPIC_ICON = '\u{2299}'` / `EPIC_FALLBACK = '[EPIC]'`, exported `epicIcon()`, an `ICON_LEGEND` entry `{ category: 'epic', glyph: ⊙, meaning: 'Epic — parent work item' }`, `iconLegendGlyphs()` adds `EPIC_ICON`; `getIconPrefixParts()` renders an epic suffix in column 4 of the row prefix (~line 879).
- `packages/herdr/src/worklist.ts` — imports `epicIcon`; hover tooltip `Type:` line prefixes `epicIcon()` for items typed epic (~line 1654); `buildMetaRows()` renders `Type: ⊙ epic` (~line 1805).
- `src/theme.ts` — CLI icon vocabulary with `EPIC_ICON` (🏰), `EPIC_FALLBACK` (`[EPIC]`), `EPIC_LABEL`, and `epicIcon()`/`epicLabel()`/`epicFallback()`, none of which currently have consumers in `src/`.
- Tests pinning the icon: `packages/herdr/src/worklist.test.ts` (`shows the epic icon on the Type row`), `tests/herdr/icons.test.ts` (`epicIcon`, `getIconPrefix` epic-type cases, alignment fixtures with epic items), `tests/unit/icons.test.ts` (`epicIcon`/`epicLabel`/`epicFallback`), `packages/shared/src/icons-legend.test.ts` (`REQUIRED_CATEGORIES` includes `'epic'`).

## Desired change

1. Remove the column-4 epic suffix from `getIconPrefixParts()` (`packages/shared/src/icons.ts`).
2. Remove the `epicIcon()` usage from the hover-tooltip `Type:` line (`formatTooltipLines`) and the metadata Type row (`buildMetaRows`) in `packages/herdr/src/worklist.ts`; drop the `epicIcon` import and any now-stale doc comments.
3. Delete the epic legend entry (`ICON_LEGEND`) and the `glyphs.add(EPIC_ICON)` line (`iconLegendGlyphs`); drop `'epic'` from `REQUIRED_CATEGORIES` in `icons-legend.test.ts`.
4. Delete `epicIcon`/`EPIC_ICON`/`EPIC_FALLBACK` from the shared module and `epicIcon`/`epicLabel`/`epicFallback`/`EPIC_ICON`/`EPIC_FALLBACK`/`EPIC_LABEL` from `src/theme.ts` (CLI copy), plus their unit tests.
5. Update all affected tests and doc comments; run the full suite.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `packages/shared/src/icons.ts` — remove `epicSuffix` column from `getIconPrefixParts`, `epicIcon()`, `EPIC_ICON`/`EPIC_FALLBACK`, legend entry + glyph-catalog line.
- `packages/herdr/src/worklist.ts` — remove `epicIcon` import + tooltip/metadata usage + stale doc-comment references (~lines 28, 1654, 1729, 1805).
- `packages/herdr/README.md` — drop `Epic` from the help-screen legend category list (~line 1774) and reword the Metadata-panel description of the Type row (~lines 1814–1815).
- `src/theme.ts` — remove CLI epic helpers/constants.
- `packages/shared/src/icons-legend.test.ts` — drop `'epic'` required category.
- `packages/herdr/src/worklist.test.ts` — epic-Type-row test updated.
- `tests/herdr/icons.test.ts` — `epicIcon`/`getIconPrefix` epic cases updated/removed.
- `tests/unit/icons.test.ts` — `epicIcon`/`epicLabel`/`epicFallback` tests removed.

## Related work

- WL-0MSGIXHHI009KFW9 — herdr selection list: metadata section uses the same icons as the list (the consistency invariant this change must preserve).
- WL-0MTQYTA20009YXBT / WL-0MS5UR9MY004UY69 — priority icon + fixed-width icon-prefix alignment (the layout contract preserved by AC1).
- WL-0MTV97GV20088CS7 — help screen and improved help line (parent of the icon-legend drift guard; open).
- WL-0MV85R2G6000G7BU / WL-0MV85R1V6000IL4E — icon legend implementation + coverage test (the catalog/legend entries being removed).
- WL-0MS4L81QF0013081 — Tab key to expand/collapse children in selection browser (the children dropdown that makes the epic icon redundant).
- WL-0MSQ3FH1K000MMJW — can expand second-level children (expand indicator coverage).
- WL-0MQHYI4E60075SQT — fix icon prefix alignment in Pi TUI work item selection list (alignment contract preserved by AC1; surfaced by automated find-related report).
- WL-0MM1CD3SP1CO6NK9 — childless critical epics invisible to `wl next` (notes childless epics exist — context for the redundancy rationale).

## Risks and assumptions

- **Assumption (scope):** "remove the icon for epic" covers the herdr list, metadata panel, hover tooltip, help legend, and both icons modules (shared + CLI `src/theme.ts`), per the producer's answers to Q1–Q3.
- **Assumption:** the plain `epic` text label remains the Type display everywhere; only the glyph is removed.
- **Risk:** removing the column-4 suffix could shift column alignment — mitigated by the padding logic in `getIconPrefixParts` (pads to `ICON_PREFIX_WIDTH`), pinned by alignment tests.
- **Risk:** the CLI `src/theme.ts` helpers may be consumed by external/tooling code not found by repo grep — accepted per producer's explicit "delete them" answer; if a test run surfaces a consumer, re-add minimal coverage as a follow-up.
- **Scope-creep risk:** extending the removal to the CLI's *rendered output* (e.g. `wl search`/`wl next` Type columns) is not part of this change — the CLI copy is only being stripped of now-unused helpers; other icon vocabulary stays.

## Plan: changelog

- 2026-10-17 — Intake: claimed; context gathered (3 render sites + legend + two icon modules + 4 test files); three clarifying questions answered by the producer (remove all three render sites; remove legend entry + catalog glyph; delete the helpers/constants); brief drafted and reviewed.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

- Q: "The ⊙ appears in three places (list rows, metadata panel Type row, hover tooltip). Remove from all three, or list rows only?" — Answer (rgardler): "all three". Source: interactive reply.
- Q: "The ⊙ has an entry in `ICON_LEGEND` + the `iconLegendGlyphs()` catalog, policed by a drift-guard test. Remove the entry with the icon, or keep it?" — Answer (rgardler): "remove both". Source: interactive reply.
- Q: "After removal, `epicIcon()`, `EPIC_ICON`, `EPIC_FALLBACK`, and the CLI's parallel `src/theme.ts` copy become unreferenced in herdr. Delete them too, or leave them as exported API?" — Answer (rgardler): "delete them". Source: interactive reply.

## Failure Signature

- Test name: packages/herdr/src/worklist-agent-state-event.test.ts > worklist — event-driven agent status (WL-0MSHB7DHO004RHBJ) > pane_agent_status_changed flips an existing icon to blocked
- Failing commit: (not available)
- CI job: (not available)

## Evidence

- Short stderr/stdout excerpt (first 1k characters):

```
AssertionError: expected output to contain RED_CIRCLE (⛔) after pane_agent_status_changed (blocked) event; event-driven icon update did not land within the 100ms sleep — pre-existing flaky real-timer test (fails intermittently on baseline f4412304 and on dev tip)
```

## Steps To Reproduce

1. Checkout the commit: `git checkout <commit-hash>`
2. Run the failing test: `pytest -q -r a --disable-warnings -k 'packages/herdr/src/worklist-agent-state-event.test.ts > worklist — event-driven agent status (WL-0MSHB7DHO004RHBJ) > pane_agent_status_changed flips an existing icon to blocked'` (or equivalent command)
3. Capture full logs and attach to the work item

## Impact

Failing test detected by agent during automated run. May block PR creation for the agent's current work item.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. The test `packages/herdr/src/worklist-agent-state-event.test.ts > worklist — event-driven agent status (WL-0MSHB7DHO004RHBJ) > pane_agent_status_changed flips an existing icon to blocked` passes when run against the latest `dev`.
2. All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes.
3. Full project test suite passes with the new changes.

## Suggested Triage Steps

1. Verify flakiness: rerun CI/test locally once.
2. If reproducible, assign to `Build` and route for triage.
3. If flaky, tag `flaky` and route to flaky-test queue.

## Suspected Owner

Build (confidence: 0.0, reason: no owner inference available)

- Runbook: skill/triage/resources/runbook-test-failure.md
